limits: Expected kernel is the committed LPASS-fixed 7.2.5, whereas the preceding Linux boot used the C9 experimental image; this is not an identical-input A/B comparison.
The chosen marker confirms checked Linux GO/FDT publication. It does not prove optical recovery or panel command acknowledgement.
Both initial and automatic-cycle touch resumes timed out waiting for ReK, remaining at 0xa0 after firmware transfer success.
DRM active/framebuffer and backlight register values are software/readback evidence, not proof of light, rail voltages, valid panel reception or actual pixel scanning.
Zero MDSS/DSI interrupt delta during idle does not by itself prove stopped scanout; vblank interrupts may be disabled.
The MDP RCG configuration warning and RPMh trace also appear in historical boots and are not unique to r5.
No display modeset, power cycle, brightness write, GDM restart, raw MMIO, clk_summary read, deployment or reboot was performed in this capture.
